wacli-pro 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Enables professional, context-aware WhatsApp messaging via the wacli CLI.
- Supports chat history search, natural-sounding message drafting, file sending, and follow-ups.
- Prioritizes concise, human, and relationship-aware wording over AI or generic phrasing.
- Includes strict confirmation, privacy, and safety policies before sending any messages.
- Offers troubleshooting guidance and direct access to reference workflows.
